facts.why: The access badge photo shows Max, not the Gyro Captain, so the name and the picture do not match.

vibe.verdict: Strong on the film's food, with the Dinki Di tin, the snake and the boomerang, held back by a plain ration sheet and a wrong badge.
missing: Fricassee of reptile (the Gyro Captain's snake, in his gyrocopter)
I'm just here for the gasoline (Max at the compound gate)
Just walk away (the Humungus at the siege)
Max's dog and the can he tosses (the hill above the refinery)
The tanker full of sand (the ending)
ideas: Swap the badge name 'Gyro Captain' for 'Max'
Swap 'Gyro Captain's frankfurt pastry snake' note for 'Fricassee of reptile, his words'
Swap 'Wasteland tin dinner' note for 'Dinki Di, dog's dinner, shared with the dog'
Add a printed 'Just walk away' on the ration sheet header
